Backend: 32/32 pytest pass (14 new + 18 regression). Background email tasks (newsletter/order/assessment/booking) do not block responses — SES may silently fail in sandbox, endpoints still return ok:true.

ui_bugs.issue: Streamed Claude tokens have missing whitespace between many words (observed: 'demandsfor energy', 'lifestyleUtkarsha**', 'butformulated for', 'rituals[Dosha Quiz]'). Root cause: server yields `data: {token}\n\n` and the SSE spec / browser EventSource (or the client's manual line.slice/trim) strips ONE leading space after 'data:' — so any token chunk that starts with a space loses it. Markdown bold ** also bleeds through unparsed because the panel renders raw text, not markdown.

issues: Header still appears to render the wordmark as styled text '3TATTAVA' on home + find-us + admin (cream + ink variants). If LOGO_WORDMARK is supposed to be an , confirm it is wrapped in and not a fallback CSS text. Screenshot review only — may already be correct since the CDN image renders identically to a styled wordmark.

action_items: ENHANCEMENT (optional): Markdown rendering in chatbot panel — Claude outputs **bold** + [Dosha Quiz](/dosha-quiz) markdown links which currently appear as raw asterisks/brackets.
VERIFY (cosmetic): Confirm Header.jsx + Footer.jsx render (not styled text fallback). Screenshot shows wordmark that could be either.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py SSE generator concatenates tokens without preserving leading whitespace — SSE spec strips one space after `data:`. See: https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/server-sent-events.html#dispatchMessage — fix as above.

chat_service.py history replay prepends `User: ...\nAssistant: ...` into the user message, which can confuse Claude since the same context is also keyed by session_id in LlmChat. Prefer passing only the new user message — LlmChat already maintains history per session_id (if it persists).
email_service.py — boto3 SES client created per-call inside `asyncio.to_thread`. For sustained traffic, cache the client at module level (still thread-safe). Currently fine for low volume.

server.py /api/admin/products PUT — accepts new slug in body but uses path slug for lookup; if body.slug != path slug, the body slug overwrites the path slug. Either ignore body.slug on update or validate they match.

server.py admin product CREATE returns doc that may include _id (line 706 `doc.pop('_id', None)` AFTER insert_one — motor mutates the dict in place adding _id. The pop fixes it; verified test response had no `_id`. Good.)
server.py — chat_stream endpoint passes raw token text in SSE without escaping; tokens may contain `\n` or even literal `\ndata:` substrings — could break parsing. JSON-encoded payloads are safer.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on new flows except minor SSE whitespace bug
